name: Andaz Singapore
short_description: A 347-room Andaz in Kampong Glam, connected to Bugis MRT, with a Level 25 infinity pool and a rooftop bar on Level 39.
ai_summary: Andaz Singapore sits in Kampong Glam, directly connected to Bugis MRT station and within reach of Little India and Bras Basah on foot. The 347-room hotel, designed by André Fu, draws consistently strong guest feedback -- reviewers repeatedly call the rooms among the best they've stayed in and single out breakfast as a highlight. The Level 25 infinity pool and Mr. Stork rooftop bar on Level 39 give it a distinct lifestyle-hotel feel rather than a conventional business-hotel one, and its cultural-district location trades the polish of Orchard Road for a livelier, more local neighborhood.

faqs.question: Is Andaz Singapore connected to the MRT?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the hotel is directly connected to Bugis MRT station via underground pedestrian walkways, putting it at the crossroads of the Kampong Glam, Little India, and Bras Basah Bugis cultural districts without needing a taxi.

faqs.question: What is there to do at Andaz Singapore besides the rooms?
faqs.answer: The hotel's Level 25 infinity pool has skyline views, the Sunroom offers all-day complimentary coffee, tea, and snacks, and Mr. Stork, a rooftop bar on Level 39 with teepee-hut seating, serves drinks and food with 360-degree city views.

source_mix.label: Secret Life of Fatbacks hotel review

reviews.title: Review: Andaz Singapore - a characterful city-centre hotel
reviews.summary: Praises the hotel's distinctive lifestyle design and spacious, thoughtfully laid-out rooms, calling out the rooftop bar and MRT connectivity, with attentive service making it a hotel the reviewer would happily return to.
